candidate.definition_en: To intend to convey, indicate, or refer to a particular thing.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعني أو يقصد حاجة معينة لما يتكلم.

senses.definition_en: To express, signify, or indicate a particular idea or thing.
senses.explanation_ar: يدل على أو يعبر عن معنى محدد.

senses.definition_en: To intend or have something in mind as a purpose.
senses.explanation_ar: يقصد أو ينوي فعل شيء معين.
examples: I didn't mean to hurt you.
I didn't mean to hurt you.
